name: document-svg
description: Convert PDF and Microsoft Office documents to SVG pages and package SVG pages back into OOXML files.

interface.shortDescription: Convert between documents and SVG pages.
interface.longDescription: Converts PDF, PPTX, XLSX, and DOCX files into deterministic per-page SVG files, and packages SVG pages back into PPTX, DOCX, or XLSX while preserving vector appearance.
defaultPrompt: Convert this PDF or Office document into SVG pages and check the warnings.
Create SVG previews for this presentation.
Package these SVG pages back into a PowerPoint file.
